en: The Section on Further Exposition, Chapter Nine: Convergence (Sampāta)
The Application of the Mode of Conveying Reversal:
In this context, what is the application of the mode of conveying reversal?
It is the verse beginning: “Therefore, for one whose mind is guarded, the range of right intention...”
When serenity and insight have been developed, cessation is the fruit; suffering has been fully understood, its origin has been abandoned, and the path has been developed as the antidote.
The section on the Modes of Conveying entitled "The Conversion" is concluded.
